caption:
Revenue is the result. These three numbers are the cause.

1. Speed to lead: minutes between a lead coming in and your first response
2. Lead-to-booked rate: the percent of conversations that become appointments
3. Show-up rate: the percent of bookings that show up

Very few service businesses respond to a new lead within the first hour, according to widely cited lead response research. Respond within five minutes instead and you significantly improve your odds of closing it.

Track all three every week, in that order. Fix booking before you fix speed and you just move the leak downstream.

See where your numbers stand.
